training_result.failure: CUDA OOM during the first forward pass on trainer ranks 1 and 3

utilization.sampling: approximately one-second nvidia-smi samples; busy means sampled utilization greater than zero; each pool has four GPUs

wedged_after_oom_17_42_31_to_17_49_17_ut.interpretation: two surviving trainer ranks remained busy after two peers had failed; this is not useful training utilization

bottlenecks_in_priority_order: Hard trainer-memory failure on 32 GiB cards before the first optimizer update.
Cycle-wide speculative dispatch generated two complete 24-rollout cycles to fill one 24-trace batch, leaving 18 trainable traces buffered and delaying the batch boundary.

The rollout phase alternated saturated policy generation with idle intervals while renderer and external judge work completed; average inference utilization was 58.67 percent despite 57.6 percent of samples being at least 90 percent.
Two uncertain judge outcomes created long-tail completion and were correctly excluded rather than assigned fabricated rewards.

reasons: Tensor parallel 5 is incompatible with the model's 24 attention heads and 4 key-value heads.
One 32 GiB RTX 5090 cannot host an independent 27B policy replica, so the fifth inference GPU cannot add a worker.
Four 32 GiB trainer ranks already OOMed; reducing the FSDP world size to three would increase per-rank state and cannot fit.
topology_decision.next_viable_layout: TP4 policy inference plus a trainer pool with at least four higher-memory GPUs, preferably 80 GiB with fast peer interconnect; do not rerun this 32 GiB PCIe trainer recipe unchanged.

required_repairs_before_next_gpu: Dispatch prompt groups against the remaining batch deficit and stop launching surplus groups once the target is reachable.
Balance trajectories by actual token length across trainer ranks and set a measured training-length ceiling rather than the unused 32768-token maximum.
Move or offload the frozen vision encoder for text-only stages and validate one real backward-plus-optimizer canary before a full run.
Bound judge retries and retain uncertain outcomes as censored evidence.
Fail the whole stack immediately when any distributed trainer rank exits.
